purpose: Test whether the v0.63 late-time linear-clustering response peak is stable to tangent forcing amplitude and resolves on a dense k-z grid before fitting any new late-time observational dataset.
reported_shape_diagnostics: global peak location and signed amplitude for each tangent amplitude
fraction of dense grid with |R| > 0.1, 1, and 5
contiguous half-maximum width in k at the reference peak z
contiguous half-maximum width in z at the reference peak k
response at the original v0.63 peak location
interpretation_rule: Passing lambda-invariance establishes numerical/tangent robustness of the scale-dependent feature. It is not an observational detection and lambda is a tangent forcing amplitude, not a fitted physical eta value.
anti_tuning: No survey residuals, covariances, S8 anomaly values, or new likelihood evaluations enter v0.64. The dense window is centered on the already-recorded v0.63 theory peak only.
